Legal

Privacy Policy & Terms of Use

This Privacy Policy explains how Www.fixwebsiteissues.com, managed by BIZZSOL LLC (doing business as WevTEC), collects, uses and safeguards your information.

Last updated: 10th October'2023.

This Privacy Policy is designed to help you understand how Www.fixwebsiteissues.com, managed by BIZZSOL LLC (doing business as WebTEC) (“we”, “our”, or “us”), collects, uses, and safeguards your information when you use our services. Please read this policy carefully and ensure you understand our practices regarding your personal data.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect different kinds of information including:

  • Personal Data: Such as your name, email address, phone number, and other contact details that you voluntarily provide to us.
  • Usage Data: Information on how our website is accessed and used. This may include IP addresses, browser type, pages visited, time spent, and other similar statistics.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect for various purposes, including:

  • To provide and maintain our services including Website Fixing, SEO, Web Design or graphic design etc.
  • To respond to your requests, inquiries, or feedback.
  • To monitor and analyze usage patterns and trends to improve our website.
  • To provide customer support.
  • To perform SEO activities.
  • To send newsletters or promotional materials, if you’ve opted in.

3. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track your activity on our website and store certain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse cookies, though doing so may affect the functionality of our website.

4. Security

Your security is important to us. We strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal data. However, no method of transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

5. Third-party Websites

Our website may contain links to third-party websites that are not operated by us. We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies, or practices of any third-party websites.

 

6.This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and share data related to our Google and Facebook ads campaigns. By using our services or interacting with our ads, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

6.1. Information We Collect

  • From Google and Facebook: We receive aggregated and anonymized data about users who interact with our ads. This includes demographic information, device type, and ad engagement metrics.

  • From Our Website: If you click on one of our ads and visit our website, we may collect additional information using cookies, pixel tags, and other tracking technologies. This could include the pages you visit, the duration of your visit, and the actions you take.

  • Data Sharing: We do not share personal data with third parties for their independent use without your permission. We may share anonymized and aggregated data with service providers or partners for analytics and advertising purposes.

6.2. How We Use Your Information

  • Ad Personalization: To deliver relevant ads based on your interests, behaviors, and preferences.

  • Performance Metrics: To analyze the performance of our ads, optimize our campaigns, and allocate our advertising budget effectively.

  • Remarketing: To show ads to users who’ve previously interacted with our services or visited our website.

6.3. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

  • Cookies: Small files stored on your device that allow us to recognize you and remember your preferences.

  • Pixel Tags: Tiny graphics with a unique identifier, similar in function to cookies, embedded invisibly on web pages.

Both are used to understand user behavior and improve the effectiveness of our ads.

 

6.4 Your Choices

  • Google Ads Preferences: You can adjust your ad preferences and opt-out of personalized ads by visiting Google Ads Settings.

  • Facebook Ad Preferences: Manage your ad preferences and opt-out of specific targeting via Facebook’s Ad Preferences.

7. Children’s Privacy

Our services are not directed to individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page. It’s advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.

9. Contact Us
